issue.body:
**Task:** CIIFR-NODE-N01-PR226-R0-IR · **WBS:** CIIFR-Node Page2.1 / engineering P1.1 · **Mode:** READ_ONLY.
**Current candidate:** [draft PR232](https://github.com/reallakshman19/XML_Compare_Utilities/pull/232), exact head `7f5dc773ac7bb08544d086be734e4337295088a0`, dependent on PR226 `b2b695f66fc8dfc907f2b9a493b39bd4d4109570`; main/base `fd86b21aa9dcbfbbe4f8a1d26133b7e9779448be`. Refresh live head before testing.
**Recipient:** non-author review participant `/root/n01_pr232_review`, started29 October2026 following Owner's “ok proceed”. This is an in-session agent identity; external ChatGPT chat ID UNKNOWN. Same host/account, distinct human/account independence NOT_ESTABLISHED. Root authored the repair and cannot independently accept it.
**Return:** this issue and parent #227, exact immutable Common evidence; no product edits or merge.

The original N01 return below remains FAIL/HOLD for parent PR226, not a review of the repaired candidate. Current [builder recovery report](https://github.com/reallakshman19/XML_Compare_Utilities/blob/7f5dc773ac7bb08544d086be734e4337295088a0/agents/PR232_workreport.md) and [Common repair evidence](https://github.com/reallakshman19/Common/blob/9c4a520c17a410bc91da79c77d1b7bec15a94f27/relay/AGENT_WORK/CIIFR-Node/CIIFR-NODE-WBS-P0-20261028/returns/P1-R0-REPAIR-R1-20261029/README.md) are review inputs, not independent acceptance.

**Review:** independently inspect expectations, code and exact bytes; test F1 retained Normal/Nodal plan/decisions/validated/applied state across Property navigation, intake and A/B modes, plus revocation after actual owning changes; F2 negative and unqualified-zero endpoint policy; F3 all typed pointer bounds and explicit unknown-family content; F4 visible unchanged UNKNOWN dormant restraint residue with physical ownership/span/raw evidence. Challenge a plausible surviving wrong result. Keep slot distinct from constrained DOF and stored values distinct from effective engineering semantics.

Execute the required three tests and new property-transfer-repair test, complete affected VNext with an actually completed run, and bounded Geometry. Classify the inherited branch-scope failure against base rather than skipping or weakening it. Check six source/served pairs, immutable public inputs, no new writer, legacy tab isolation and relevant seeded wrong cases. Root separately attempts real browser qualification; it remains builder evidence and is not Windows/original acceptance. Actual original only through authorized N02 custody; absence blocks original claims, not feasible code checks.

**Return per gate:** exact head, independence/exposure/provenance, native command outputs, scope of legacy/Geometry/browser/original checks, source/served, no writer, highest wrong case, PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN and bounded verdict. No product/test/oracle repair, approval, new writer, merge, release or P2 promotion. GATE_R0 remains HOLD until required evidence and acceptance are resolved. Preserve old evidence on its original candidate.

**EXACT_NEXT_ACTION:** non-author reviewer `/root/n01_pr232_review` independently qualifies this exact repair candidate and returns actual report/logs through the existing Common relay; root reconciles it without self-approving its code.
